description.p: A character sheet for Dungeons & Dragons fifth edition (2024 rules). Enter your ability scores, classes and gear, and the sheet works out modifiers, saving throws, skills, armor class, spell save DC and spell slots for you.

ul.li: Click any modifier to roll it, with advantage or disadvantage
Track hit points, hit dice, death saves, spell slots and feature uses
Short and long rests restore the right resources
Multiclassing, Pact Magic, Exhaustion and Weapon Mastery
One JSON file per character, easy to back up and share
